title: ivmediate: causal mediation analysis with a single instrument (Python, R, Stata, MATLAB)
description:
Software for the estimator of Ferrara, Gold, Heblich and Pinto (2026), Identifying Causal Mediation Effects with a Single Instrument. With one instrument for the treatment, ivmediate splits the treatment's effect on an outcome into a direct effect and an indirect effect through a mediator, without a separate instrument for the mediator. It reports Olea–Pflueger effective F-statistics for the usual and the conditional first stage, Anderson–Rubin confidence sets, and κ- and R²-based sensitivity analyses. It supports one or several instruments, one- and two-way fixed effects, weights, classical, robust, cluster and Conley standard errors, post-double-selection LASSO and the bootstrap.

The implementations in Python, R, Stata and MATLAB give the same results; they are tested against each other in the repository's validation/ folder.
